13,781 reviews. 4.5 stars. Grand World Phu Quoc is not a fluke.

This entertainment complex at Bãi Dài is massive. Canals, light shows, street food, shops, live performances, all in one place. It hits different at night when the whole strip lights up.

First time in Phu Quoc? Put this on the list. Already been? You probably missed half of it.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
